review.method: Every requested height is independently calibrated and solved in both domains. Only the declared central reporting window is displayed after the fixed sensitivity screen passes. Case checks at 3/10/20 m are not a substitute for the per-request comparison.
review.independent_checks: ANUGA 3.3.10 scalar Flather, stationary measured terrain, native target heights 3/10/20 m; analytic dam break, lake at rest, mass balance and grid refinement on synthetic cases.
